findings.evidence: `grep -n '.preimage' TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup` returns the `pointsFunctor.{u,u,u}.preimage` + `Functor.map_preimage` idiom in exactly two places: GeneralLinear/RootSubgroup.lean:162,177 and SpecialLinear/RootSubgroup.lean:179,193, with identical surrounding text.
findings.fix: Factor it into one combinator in CommHopfAlgCat/SchemePoints.lean (the file this PR already extends), parameterized by `H K : CommHopfAlgCat R`, a natural points map `τ : pointsFunctor (H := K) ⟶ pointsFunctor (H := H)` and the two named presentations: `coordinateMapOfPointsMap τ := (pointsFunctor.preimage τ).unop`, its two `mapPointsFunctor` lemmas, `groupSchemeMapOfPointsMap`/`_def`, and the scheme-points formula. Then GL and SL `rootSubgroup*` are one-line instantiations.
findings.issue: The whole scheme-level tower is copied verbatim from GeneralLinear/RootSubgroup.lean: SL 154-168 = GL 137-151 (`rootSubgroupPointsMap` + `_app`), SL 176-207 = GL 159-191 (`rootSubgroupCoordinateMap`, `mapPointsFunctor_rootSubgroupCoordinateMap`, `_app`), SL 256-272 = GL 195-211 (`rootSubgroup`, `rootSubgroup_def`), SL 278-290 = GL 217-229, SL 295-313 = GL 235-253 — identical character-for-character except for the final matrix expression and one explicit `R`. Nothing in that code depends on which Hopf algebra it is.

findings.evidence: GeneralLinear/Scheme.lean:88 `noncomputable def groupScheme := (hopfSpec (CommRingCat.of R)).obj (Opposite.op (coordinateHopfAlgebra R n))`; SpecialLinear/Basic.lean:269-273 states `groupSchemeι`'s target as the same expression; line 289 `groupSchemeι R n ≫ eqToHom (GeneralLinear.groupScheme_def R n).symm`.
findings.fix: Keep one inclusion: give `groupSchemeι` the target `GeneralLinear.groupScheme R n` and delete `groupSchemeιGeneralLinear`, `groupSchemeιGeneralLinear_def`, and `isClosedImmersion_groupSchemeιGeneralLinear`; rename the use in `rootSubgroup_comp_groupSchemeιGeneralLinear` accordingly.
findings.issue: `groupSchemeιGeneralLinear` is a wrapper duplicating `groupSchemeι`: its target `GeneralLinear.groupScheme R n` is *defined* (Scheme.lean:88-91) as `hopfSpec.obj (op (GeneralLinear.coordinateHopfAlgebra R n))`, which is exactly `groupSchemeι`'s stated target, so the two differ only by `eqToHom (GeneralLinear.groupScheme_def R n).symm`, an `eqToHom` of a `rfl`-proof. Both are public, both are in the module docstring, and both carry a closed-immersion instance whose proofs (lines 301-320 vs 322-337) are clones of one another.

findings.evidence: HopfIdeal/Scheme/Basic.lean:67-70 `quotientSpec` is an `abbrev` for `hopfSpec.obj (op (quotient H I))` and Kernel.lean:60-62 `kernelSpec f := quotientSpec K (kernelHopfIdeal f)`; SpecialLinear/Basic.lean:190 `coordinateHopfAlgebra := CommHopfAlgCat.quotient ... (definingHopfIdeal R n)` with `definingHopfIdeal := kernelHopfIdeal (determinantCoordinateMap R n)` (line 114-116), so the new `groupScheme` is reducibly the old `kernelSpec`. Basic.lean:88-91 (pre-PR diff context) shows the old 4-line instance.
findings.fix: Drop the identity `eqToHom` from `groupSchemeι` (define it as `CommHopfAlgCat.kernelSpecι (GeneralLinear.determinantCoordinateMap R n)` retyped at the named target) and restore `rw [kernelSpecι_def]; infer_instance`; `groupSchemeι_comp_determinant` then reverts to `CommHopfAlgCat.kernelSpecι_comp` without the extra `eqToHom` on the right-hand side.
findings.issue: `groupSchemeι` is now `eqToHom (groupScheme_def R n) ≫ kernelSpecι ...` where `groupScheme_def` is `rfl`-provable, and the closed-immersion instance grew from 4 lines to 15 (`MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso` on that identity `eqToHom`). The scaffolding re-derives what the existing instance `CommHopfAlgCat.isClosedImmersion_quotientSpecι` already gives through `kernelSpecι_def`, which is how the pre-PR proof discharged it.

findings.evidence: Transvection.lean:178-181 `def transvectionHom (hij) : Multiplicative A →* GL n A where toFun c := transvectionUnit hij (Multiplicative.toAdd c); map_one' := transvectionUnit_zero hij; map_mul' _ _ := transvectionUnit_add hij _ _` — the same three fields, with `transvectionUnit_zero`/`_add` themselves proved from `SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_coeff_zero`/`transvection_add` (lines 156, 162).
findings.fix: Make the `SpecialLinearGroup`-valued hom public in TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/GeneralLinearGroup/Transvection.lean next to `transvectionUnit`, and redefine `TauCeti.transvectionHom := (SpecialLinearGroup.toGL).comp` of it; use the shared declaration here instead of a private copy.
findings.issue: The private `transvectionHom : Multiplicative A →* Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin N) A` duplicates `TauCeti.transvectionHom` (Transvection.lean:178), which is literally this hom composed with `Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL`: `transvectionUnit hij c := SpecialLinearGroup.toGL (SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij c)` (Transvection.lean:144-145), and its `map_one'`/`map_mul'` come from the same `transvection_coeff_zero`/`transvection_add`.

findings.evidence: Transvection.lean:241-245 `@[simp] theorem map_transvectionUnit (f : A →+* B) ... : GeneralLinearGroup.map f (transvectionUnit hij c) = transvectionUnit hij (f c) := by ext a b; simp [GeneralLinearGroup.map, transvection, Matrix.one_apply, single, apply_ite f]`. No `SpecialLinearGroup.map`-of-transvection lemma exists in Mathlib (`Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/SpecialLinearGroup.lean` lines 490-582 list only `transvection_coe/_coeff_zero/_smul_single_*/_mul_neg/_inv/_add/_mem_center_iff`).
findings.fix: State it once at the `SpecialLinearGroup` level in Transvection.lean — `Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map f (SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij c) = SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij (f c)` — and derive `map_transvectionUnit` from it via `SpecialLinearGroup.toGL`; import it here instead of re-proving.
findings.issue: The private `map_transvection` duplicates `TauCeti.map_transvectionUnit` (Transvection.lean:242-245): the same naturality fact, proved by the same entrywise `ext` + `simp [transvection, Matrix.one_apply, single, ...]` argument, one level down the `toGL` coercion.

findings.evidence: Transvection.lean:191-194 `theorem transvectionUnit_injective (hij) : Function.Injective fun c : A => transvectionUnit hij c := fun c d h => by have h' := congrArg Units.val h; simpa [transvection, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.single_apply, hij] using congrFun₂ h' i j` versus SpecialLinear/RootSubgroup.lean:107-114.
findings.fix: Add `SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_injective` in Transvection.lean, derive `transvectionUnit_injective` from it (`transvectionUnit = toGL ∘ transvection`), and use it here so the entry argument is written once.
findings.issue: The `hparameter` step of `rootSubgroupPoints_injective` re-proves `TauCeti.transvectionUnit_injective` (Transvection.lean:191-194) inline with the identical `simpa [... Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.single_apply, hij]` entry extraction at `(i, j)`. The GL analogue (GeneralLinear/RootSubgroup.lean:104-116) correctly calls the shared lemma instead.

findings.evidence: HopfIdeal/Scheme/Kernel.lean:220-230 `theorem isPullback_kernelSpec (f : H ⟶ K) : IsPullback (kernelSpecι f) 0 (hopfSpec.map f.op) 0`. Grepping TauCeti for `isPullback_kernelSpec` returns only its own definition and docstring line — it currently has no consumers.
findings.fix: Define `rootSubgroup hij := (CommHopfAlgCat.isPullback_kernelSpec (GeneralLinear.determinantCoordinateMap R N)).lift (GeneralLinear.rootSubgroup hij) 0 h`, with `h` the determinant-triviality square obtained from `det_transvectionUnit` through `pointsFunctor` faithfulness; then `rootSubgroup_comp_groupSchemeιGeneralLinear` is `IsPullback.lift_fst` and the coordinate-level lemma can go.
findings.issue: `coordinateMap_comp_rootSubgroupCoordinateMap` (40 lines) exists only to prove `rootSubgroup_comp_groupSchemeιGeneralLinear` (line 319). Both re-derive what the existing universal property `CommHopfAlgCat.isPullback_kernelSpec` provides directly: the kernel spectrum is the fibre of `hopfSpec.map (determinantCoordinateMap R N).op` over the identity section, so the lift out of `𝔾ₐ` and its factorization are `IsPullback.lift`/`IsPullback.lift_fst`.

summary: The new SpecialLinear/RootSubgroup.lean is a near-verbatim clone of GeneralLinear/RootSubgroup.lean's definitional tower, and privately re-derives three transvection facts already public in TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/GeneralLinearGroup/Transvection.lean. In SpecialLinear/Basic.lean, `groupSchemeιGeneralLinear` is a second public name for `groupSchemeι`, with a cloned closed-immersion proof.
